Born in Alaska, raised in Zurich, and then spending his teenage years in Park City, Utah, Hall’s passion and balance for both competitive skiing and filming in the street and backcountry showcases not only his technical expertise but his adaptive style as well. Whether he’s throwing a trick with his signature Buick grab or scoping out Google Maps for the best urban skiing features to hit, there is no doubt Hall leans into and credits both disciplines for his constant creative variety. AHall’s competitive accolades are extensive - from winning gold at the Beijing 2022 Olympics on his first run of the men's slopestyle final with an incredibly difficult move on the last jump, a pull back, to turn his right double cork 1080 into a 900, a third-place finish at World Championships in both 2021 and 2025 and 12 podiums at X Games - half of which are gold medals.
